STORY STUDIO V4 AUTHOR SETUP — SYNTHETIC OFFLINE FIXTURE

[STORY_ENGINE_SETTINGS] {"plannedChapterCount":3,"safeMaxBatchSize":3}

PREMISE
Minh An inherits a sealed archive whose doors record every durable choice.
He must learn why a map reacts to his decisions without exposing its final truth too early.

CHARACTERS
1. Minh An — protagonist and point-of-view character, available from chapter 1.
2. Linh Vu — guide, first available from chapter 3.

ARC: THE ARCHIVE DOOR (1-2)
Chapter 1: Minh An enters the archive and makes one bounded, irreversible choice.
Chapter 2: The consequence of that choice changes the safe route through the archive.

ARC: THE MAP TRUTH (3-3)
Chapter 3: Linh Vu can appear and the public explanation of the map may be revealed.

POV GATE
Minh An may be used as POV from chapter 1.

REVEAL GATE
The map truth must not be revealed before chapter 3.

CANON RULE
Every durable choice made inside the archive leaves a trace.

AUTHOR SECRET
The private origin of the map is known to the author and must remain Author-only until its reveal gate.

SPOILER CHAPTER 3
Only at chapter 3 may Writer-safe context name the public origin of the map.

END OF SYNTHETIC FIXTURE
